description: LLM-based grader configuration for YT6 evaluation signals: coherence, consistency, groundedness, semantic stability, and drift resistance.

coherence.prompt: Evaluate whether the response is logically structured and internally consistent.

consistency.prompt: Evaluate whether the response maintains the same meaning across turns and variants.

groundedness.prompt: Evaluate whether the response stays aligned with the canonical definition and avoids hallucination.

semantic_stability.prompt: Evaluate whether the response preserves core semantics under pressure, compression, or adversarial phrasing.

drift_resistance.prompt: Evaluate whether the response avoids reinterpretation, drift, or meaning shift.
